title: fastapi: Bug report from a user of this library
prompt:
This repo is fastapi (an open-source Python library). Bug report from a user of this library:

> Streaming endpoints write invalid JSON for non-finite floats. A JSONL endpoint (an async generator path operation with no return annotation) or a Server-Sent Events endpoint (`response_class=EventSourceResponse`, or yielding `ServerSentEvent(data=...)`) that yields `float('nan')`, `float('inf')` or `float('-inf')`, alone, nested in dicts and lists, or inside a Pydantic model, sends bare `NaN` / `Infinity` tokens, which clients' JSON parsers reject. Each item should be serialized the way Pydantic serializes JSON by default (`pydantic_core.to_json`): non-finite floats become `null`, everything else unchanged. A model that sets its own `ser_json_inf_nan` must keep that setting, and `ServerSentEvent(raw_data=...)` must still be sent exactly as given.

Run the tests with `python3 -m pytest tests` (the package is importable from the repo as it is). Fix the bug in the library code and add a regression test. Keep the existing tests passing.
